task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Move the red can with gold patterns from its spot to near the round kitchenpot with two side grips
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架将带有金色图案的红色罐头从其位置移动到带有两个侧把手的圆形厨房锅附近
